# Dictionary attribution

This game includes a filtered copy of `wordfreq-en-25000-log.json` from
[aparrish/wordfreq-en-25000](https://github.com/aparrish/wordfreq-en-25000),
an English word-frequency export based on Robyn Speer’s
[wordfreq](https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq) project.

The data is licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
The original project documents its source data and required attributions.

It also includes `frequency-en-50000.txt` from
[hermitdave/FrequencyWords](https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords),
an OpenSubtitles 2018-derived English frequency list. Its content is licensed
under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Rarity scoring uses `wordfreq-en-large.json`, exported
from [rspeer/wordfreq](https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq)'s large English
frequency dictionary. The package is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

Answer validation uses the NASPA Word List 2023 Edition (NWL2023), sourced
from a [public mirror](https://github.com/ililim/liv-word-finder) pinned to
commit `386e730`.
